items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: And then, after Noble Sissle[?], she was with Charlie Barnet.

ctx.x: Yeah, that's when I first met her. And then, after Noble Sissle[?], she was with Charlie Barnet. The next time I saw her after that, it was in California, Los Angeles. We was, we was out there for the theater. It was in Los Angeles for the week.
But, I'm gonna attempt to try to see her show. I understand it's a sellout all the time.
